The '''Meligin Asteroid Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a probe owned by [[Tashelin Industries]] crashed while exploring the belt, and it was discovered to have been sabotaged by a corporate rival.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Missing Probes}}</ref>
